# Bad Syntax Examples
# This file demonstrates bracket matching errors for CK3001 and CK3002

namespace = syntax_bad

# ERROR CK3001: Unmatched closing bracket - extra closing brace
syntax_bad.0001 = {
	type = character_event
	title = syntax_bad.0001.t
	desc = syntax_bad.0001.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = syntax_bad.0001.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
} # EXTRA CLOSING BRACE - no matching opening brace above this
}

# ERROR CK3002: Unclosed bracket - missing closing brace
syntax_bad.0002 = {
	type = character_event
	title = syntax_bad.0002.t
	desc = syntax_bad.0002.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = syntax_bad.0002.a
		add_gold = 100
	# MISSING CLOSING BRACE for option block

# ERROR CK3002: Unclosed bracket in nested structure
syntax_bad.0003 = {
	type = character_event
	title = syntax_bad.0003.t
	desc = syntax_bad.0003.desc

	trigger = {
		age >= 16
		OR = {
			is_ruler = yes
			AND = {
				is_landed = yes
				is_adult = yes
			# MISSING CLOSING BRACE for AND block
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = syntax_bad.0003.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}

# ERROR CK3001: Unmatched closing bracket in if/else chain
syntax_bad.0004 = {
	type = character_event
	title = syntax_bad.0004.t
	desc = syntax_bad.0004.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		if = {
			limit = { gold >= 100 }
			add_prestige = 50
		}
		else = {
			add_piety = 25
		}
	}
} # Extra closing brace
}

# ERROR CK3002: Missing closing brace for event
syntax_bad.0005 = {
	type = character_event
	title = syntax_bad.0005.t
	desc = syntax_bad.0005.desc

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = syntax_bad.0005.a
		add_gold = 100
	}
# MISSING CLOSING BRACE for entire event

# ERROR CK3002: Unclosed limit block
syntax_bad_effect = {
	every_vassal = {
		limit = {
			is_adult = yes
			NOT = {
				has_trait = lazy
			# MISSING CLOSING BRACE for NOT block
		}
		add_opinion = {
			target = root
			modifier = grateful_opinion
		}
	}
}

# ERROR CK3001: Too many closing braces in decision
syntax_bad_decision = {
	picture = "gfx/interface/illustrations/decisions/decision_misc.dds"

	is_shown = {
		is_ruler = yes
	}

	effect = {
		add_prestige = 100
	}
	}
} # Two extra closing braces

# ERROR CK3002: Missing closing for triggered_desc
syntax_bad.0006 = {
	type = character_event
	title = syntax_bad.0006.t
	desc = {
		triggered_desc = {
			trigger = {
				has_trait = brave
			# MISSING CLOSING BRACE for trigger
			desc = syntax_bad.0006.desc_brave
		}
	}

	trigger = {
		is_adult = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = syntax_bad.0006.a
		add_gold = 50
	}
}

# ERROR CK3001: Unmatched closing in complex nesting
syntax_bad.0007 = {
	type = character_event
	title = syntax_bad.0007.t
	desc = syntax_bad.0007.desc

	trigger = {
		OR = {
			is_ruler = yes
			}
		} # Extra closing brace
	}

	option = {
		name = syntax_bad.0007.a
		add_prestige = 50
	}
}
